errors.evidence: The description states that the 'Accuracy' line begins at an x-value of approximately 10. However, by visual inspection, the first data point is located at an x-coordinate of approximately 15. This same minor inaccuracy is repeated for the starting points of the 'Confidence' line ('startet bei x ≈ 10') and the 'Alignment' line ('beginnt bei x ≈ 10').
